engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.primary: repairs and maintains gear; patches hull damage

effects.loyal: faster repairs; small chance to restore a damaged fitting mid-fight
effects.uneasy: slower repairs; chance a repair fails
effects.hostile: may sabotage a fitting or abandon a repair, then leave

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.primary: steers the vessel, manages altitude and wind

effects.loyal: +5% speed in favorable wind; smoother altitude changes
effects.hostile: may refuse a risky climb or dive, then leave
